items.title: 2026-10-14 ★ HMUC - New features
items.text:
→ You can now update supported mods DIRECTLY from the main menu.
→ Update HMUC manually one last time, then enjoy much easier updates for your other supported mods.

items.title: 2026-10-17 ★ HPO - New features
items.text:
→ Cross-department Patient transport.
→ Native Porter needs and breaks restored.
→ More natural post-transport return flow.

items.title: 2026-10-17 ★ HTC - Fixes (check XML settings)
items.text:
→ Better bucket cart parking.
→ Safer janitor behavior around occupied rooms.
→ Improved nighttime cleaning priorities.

items.title: 2026-10-17 ★ Hospital Flow Optimizer - [[ -- NEW MOD -- ]]
items.text:
